title: FREE REQUEST Looking for help for a large ongoing project

posts.author: Elboomo55
posts.body:
I'm requesting help for a slight passion project of mine, mostly want to try to do something with the time I have now. Been writing a book and want to try to adapt it to a game. Have experience with RPG makers, mostly VX Ace, but I am planning on using MZ with this current project. The story is Sci-fi fantasy, thinking with industrial themes for a mega city, like FF7ish with Anthro characters, humans causing conflict, and a chosen hero story with a twist. I could talk more, but I should get to the post because otherwise this will be WAY too long.
Engine:
RPG Maker MZ
Synopsis
:
JRPG with active time battle, game taking place from a small village at the start, to mega city, to escaping it ending part 1(or what is currently planned)
My Role:
I will be making the maps, eventing, setting up plugins I install, puzzles, story setting and much of the putting things together end of the work.
Positions Needed:
- Music Composure
- Pixel artist(Characters, Animated battlers, battle backgrounds, vehicles, tilesets)
- Possibly someone who can make custom plugins for like minigames that can't be created easily
- Someone I can bounce ideas with for the story or has an active interest in the theme of the game (An idea's person(s))
I know it's a big ask for a personal project and I shouldn't really be requesting something like not being very well known, but I don't have much to offer on the table. I won't make this commercial for certain, think I'll make the book go down that route rather than this big ask as is.
